description: This file defines a Java interface 'PersistenceCleanupConfig' that specifies configuration settings for persistence cleanup operations within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for retrieving configuration parameters such as timeout durations, parallelism, and retention counts, and provides default values via an enum 'ConfigValue'. It also contains a static method to create a config instance from a HOCON configuration object.

classes.name: PersistenceCleanupConfig
classes.description: An interface that provides configuration settings for persistence cleanup actions, extending BackgroundStreamingConfig.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether background cleanup is enabled.

methods.name: getQuietPeriod
methods.description: Returns the duration between service startup and the beginning of cleanup actions.

methods.name: getKeptEvents
methods.description: Returns the number of events to keep in the actor state.

methods.name: getCleanupTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for cleanup responses.

methods.name: getParallelism
methods.description: Returns the number of cleanup commands to execute in parallel.

methods.name: getCreditDecisionConfig
methods.description: Returns configuration settings for credit decisions.

methods.name: getPersistenceIdsConfig
methods.description: Returns configuration settings for the persistence ID stream.

methods.name: getKeptCreditDecisions
methods.description: Returns the number of credit decisions to keep in the actor state.

methods.name: getKeptActions
methods.description: Returns the number of actions to keep in the actor state.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration in HOCON format.

methods.name: fromConfig
methods.description: Creates a PersistenceCleanupConfig instance from a HOCON config object.
